blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. heaped praise on Alex Eala during the Filipino tennis sensation’s homecoming event at Pasig Central Elementary School on Tuesday. Marcos commended Eala’s humility amid her growing stardom as one of tennis’ brightest young stars and biggest draws. “Eala has brought pride and glory to the Philippines, everywhere she goes,” said Marcos.
